tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅/ /rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal kyai'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas rten la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkhyen rab khyon yangs 'jig rten kun gyi mig /thugs rje'i zur gyi blta ba'i rnam rol gyis/ /srid gsum skyong mdzad rje btsun bla ma dang / /dbyer med yi dam lha yi tshogs la 'dud/ /don dam dbyings la spros pa mi mnga' yang / /kun rdzob rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga yis/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dge legs spel byed pa'i/ /rab gnas cho ga ji bzhin bshad kyis nyon/ /'di la/ rten gyi bya ba yongs rdzogs nas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid gnas dang dus/ /yo byad yongs su tshang nas ni/ /cho ga dag la 'jug par bya/ /zhes pa ltar don drug las/ dang po gang la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten lugs ma dang / bris pa dang / 'bur du byas pa la sogs pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang / gtsug lag khang la sogs pa bzo bo'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin pa'o/ /gnyis pa gang gis rab tu gnas par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ de nyid bcu shes shing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa bsnyen pa las su rung zhing cho ga la mkhas pa/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti la mi lta ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /gsum pa gang du rab tu gnas par bya ba'i gnas ni/ bkra shis shing nyams dga' ba'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa shin du yangs pa'i sa phyogs su'o/ /bzhi pa nam bya ba'i dus ni/ tshes dang gza' skar khyad par can 'dzom pa'i yar gyi ngo la/ gza' skar lhag par bzang na mar gyi ngo la'ang rung zhing / dpyid zla 'bring po sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i dus dang / dgun zla 'bring po 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi dus gnyis ni gzhan las khyad par du 'phags par bshad do/ /lnga pa yo byad ni/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med cing gya nom pa rnams gsag go

/drug pa cho ga la dngos dang / de'i phan yon gnyis kyi dang po la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'byung ba las/ 'bring po'i tshul brjod na don gsum ste/ sta gon dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes so/ /dang po ni/ legs bshams tshul bzhin bya ba ni/ /'bring po'i sta gon nyid yin no/ /zhes te/ rten spyan drangs du mi btub na de'i mdun du dang / spyan drangs du btub na stegs bu mthon po'i steng du shar la sogs par zhal gzigs par byas la dar ram ras la sogs pas g.yogs te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pas bsrung ngo / /de'i mdun du chu bzhi'am chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod re re la'ang ci tsam 'byor pa breng tshar du bsham/ de'i mdun du khrus sa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru bzhi dpangs su khru gcig gam gnyis yod pa bya/ rtsig pa ma grub na rdul tshon ser pos khru bzhi pa'i gru bzhi pa bris te/ de'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris la/ der dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang / mtshams bzhir yum bzhi'i mtshan ma 'bri ba'am/ yang na bla ma dag dbus su rin po che cha dgu pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bri ba mdzad pas de ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /de'i dbus su mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du gser dngul lam zangs kyi khrus gzhong bu ga dang bral ba bzhag la/ der sngar rab gnas byas pa'i rten chung ngu zhig gam/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam/ rdo rje la sogs pa gzhag de dang nye bar maṇḍal lam/ gro ga la gur gum mam/ gi waṃ gis yi ge gsum dang / oṃ sarba bidyā swā hā zhes pa dang / rten 'brel snying po rnams bris la gzhag go /'dab brgyad so so'i steng du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa brgyad du dri bzang po'i chu dang / 'og nas bshad pa ltar so so'i rdzas kyis bkang / kha rgyan dang mgul chings sogs kyis brgyan pa bsham/ 'bring po'i skabs 'dir de lta bu'i khrus stegs dang khrus bum brgyad ma 'byor na rnam rgyal dang /

las bum dang / khrus rdzas brgyad char bum pa gcig tu blugs pa'i khrus bum dang gsum stegs gang yang rung ba'i steng du bsham/ khrus stegs de'i mdun du dūrba'i pir dang / dri bzang btab pa'i til mar dang / sran dkar gyi phye ma dang / me long dang / ras dkar po'i sku phyi ba dang / bgegs dang dri ma sbyong ba'i yo byad rnams kyang bsham/ khrus stegs kyi g.yas phyogs su yi dam dang / chos skyong che chung dang / las mgon gyi gtor ma dang / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams bsham/ khrus stegs kyi g.yon phyogs su rab gnas kyi lha la mchod pa'i maṇḍal gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa bris te/ de'ang phyogs re la cha lnga lnga ste bcu par byas la dbus kyi cha gnyis la padma 'dab brgyad bri/ phyi rol gyi zur nas bskor la lcags ri bya/ phyogs bzhi nas mchod rten ltar je chung du btang la/ ri rab bang rim bzhi pa/ shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser po/ zur bzhi'i re mig rnams sngon po bya/ de'i phyi rol du shar du zla gam/ lhor sog kha/ nub tu zlum po/ byang du gru bzhi ste gling bzhi dang / de dag gi g.yas g.yon du gling phran gnyis gnyis/ dbyibs sngar dang 'dra bar byas pa bri/ gling phran gyi khyams g.yas g.yon la shar du dpal be'u/ 'khor lo/ lhor padma/ rgyal mtshan/ nub tu gdugs/ bum pa/ byang du dung dang nya bri zhing / mtha'i lcags ri sngon po bya'o/ /dbus kyi padma'i steng du rin po che sna bdun gyi gzugs dgod/ gzhan yang bla re dang / dar gyi lda ldi dang / rol mo la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad thams cad ma tshang ba med par gsag go /slob dpon dpon slob rnams kyi gdan rten la kha phyogs par bshams pa'i mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams kyang bsham mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ tho rangs bdag bskyed bum pa bzla/ /rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang / /ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab/

/rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab/ /dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya/ /gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya/ /de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang / /sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi'o/ /zhes tshig rkang dang po 'don pa cung zad bsgyur te/ don bcu gsum las dang po bdag bskyed cing bum pa bzlas pa ni/ sang tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ gos ser po gyon/ stan la 'dug ste/ gnas yo byad byin dbab pa dang / lha'i rnal 'byor la gsol ba gdab pa dbang chu nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te kyai rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas te/ dkyil 'khor bsdus la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de nas rnam rgyal dang las bum gnyis bskyed chog dbang chu ltar byas nas las bum gyi chus khrus bum brgyad dam gcig la gtor te a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang so so'i rdzas kyis yongs su gang bar bsam la/ gzungs thag btags pa la bzung ste/ dri lnga blugs pa'i bum pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandhe sna nā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ de bzhin du gandhe'i gnas su so so'i sngags rnams sbyar la mngar gsum gyi bum pa la tri ma du dang / zho'i bum pa la ma la dang / 'bras bu'i la spha la dang / 'bru'i la bru hi dang / 'bras yos kyi la lardza dang / sman gyi la she ta dang / rin po che'i bum pa la ma ṇi sna nā zhes sbyar la brgya rtsa re bzla/ thun mong du gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs dang /

las thams cad pa'i sngags ci nus su bzlas la/ nang rdzas rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i so so'i bum pa rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par blta'o/ /gnyis pa rten sbyang ba ni/ rten dgab pa yod na bsal la/ thog mar bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma gsum bshams la/ chus bran nas lan gsum du rten la bskor zhing oṃ sarba bignān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo/ bi shwa mu khe bhya/ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ ba liṃ ta swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis shig ces zhi bas sbyang ba dang / ting lo dang chang bu rten la bskor zhing rdo rje gsor/ sumbha ni bzlas pa lan gsum byas nas sngar gyi tshig gi rjes la gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod la gtor ma phyir dor ba zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang / de nas rang khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dril bu dang spos thogs te/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis khro bo spyan drangs/ gdan dang mchod pa mdor bsdus phul nas/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /zhes pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstod la/ kyai rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ste/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang /

dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis deng 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim par gyis la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par rang rang gi gnas su song shig gal te mi 'gro na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes drag tu brjod la rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ mtshon chas bsdig sna tshogs pa'i rol mo drag tu bya zhing / rtsa sngags dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags sogs drag sngags mang du bzla/ sems kyis bgegs thams cad phyi rol du bros par bsam pa ni drag po'i sbyang ba'o/ /de nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ rang gi mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag la/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib rnams snying ga nas yi ge kam̐ nag po'i rnam par 'thon nas/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ de g.yas kyi ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon gyi rgya mtshos bkrus par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/ rten gsar pa la khrus bya ba'i sngon du khrus stegs kyi steng gi rten dang yig 'bru rnams la las bum gyi chus khrus bya zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /zhes sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/

zhes brjod/ de dag sku la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang sngags kyis sku phyi'o/ /de nas chu de khrus bum brgyad por cung zad re blugs la lugs ma la sogs pa bkrur rung ba rnams rol mo dang bcas pas khrus stegs su spyan drangs la dngos su bkru/ de ltar mi rung ba rnams la me long gi nang du rten gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba byas la/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i lus sems sdug bsngal bsal slad du/ /chu gtsang sman spos 'dag chal 'dis bkrus pas/ /bdag cag dam pa'i sku mchog thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing / thog mar til mar la dri bzang btab pas me long la byug de nas yang sngags brjod cing sran dkar gyi 'dag chal gyis mnye/ yang sngags brjod cing dūrba'i pir gyis drud/ chu gtsang mas kyang bkru'o/ /de nas dri'i bum pas bkru zhing / 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /sogs dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gandhe sna nā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas ras dkar po la gur gum gyi chus dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥzhes bris pa'am/ ma 'byor na de dag brjod bzhin du thig le lnga byas la de las kyi rdo rje'i phrag pa g.yon pa la bkal te des dngos su phyi ba'am me long gi gzugs brnyan la phyi zhing / de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi 'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā zhes brjod/ de bzhin du bum pa 'og ma rnams kyis bkru ba'i tshe'ang sngon du rdzas gsum gyis byug pa dang / bar du rang rang gi bum pas bkru ba dang / mthar sku phyi ba rnams thams cad la shes par bya'o/ /de nas rdzas gsum gyis sngar ltar byugs la/ mngar gsum gyi bum pas bkru zhing / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /sogs dang /

tri ma du sna nā sogs kyis bkru zhing sku phyi'o/ /yang byug cing zho'i bum pas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / ma la sna nā sogs kyis bkru zhing sku phyi'o/ /yang byug cing 'bras bu sna tshogs kyi bum pas/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / spha la sna nā sogs kyis bkru zhing sku phyi'o/ /yang byug cing 'bru sna tshogs kyi bum pas/ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / bru hi sna nā sogs kyis bkru zhing sku phyi'o/ /yang byug cing 'bras yos kyi bum pas/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / lardza sna nā sogs kyis bkru zhing sku phyi'o/ /yang byug cing sman gyi bum pas/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / she ta sna nā sogs kyis bkru zhing sku phyi'o/ /yang byug cing rin po che'i bum pas/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /sogs dang / /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi sna nā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bkru/ de dag sku la sogs brjod cing ras kyis phyi'o/ /des nas dri'i bum pa thogs te/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /sogs tshigs bcad gsum brjod cing bkru'o/ /des nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /zhes pa nas/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /ces pa'i bar tshigs bcad bco lnga brjod cing me tog gtor/ de nas dri'i bum pas bkru zhing / ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing / de dag sku la zhes sogs kyis sku phyi'o/ /khrus bum gcig las med na rten gsar pa bkru ba rnams de nyid kyis bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa ring bsrel gzhug pa ni/ sku gzugs rnams kyi dbu'i rgyab phyogs su bug pa yod na/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel lam rig sngags chen mo dang / rten 'brel snying po dang /

sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yi/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /sems kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du yang sdom pa legs/ /zhes pa'i so sor thar pa rnams gzhug bu ga med pa'am/ mchod rten dang sku gzugs sngar gzhug zin pa yin na ring bsrel mi dgos la/ gzungs dang so sor thar pa bris pa dbu'am bre la gdags so/ /lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpon slob rnams langs la/ lag tu me tog dang rol mo thogs nas yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das te/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dgos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ stobs bcu dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum dang / thugs rje chen po la sogs pa mdor na slob pa dang / mi slob pa'i sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos rnams dang ldan pa de'i skyon gyi nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyi bla na med pa'i tshul khrims la sogs pa phung po lnga dang yang dag par ldan pa dang / cho 'phrul gsum dang / ting nge 'dzin gsum dang / bslab pa gsum dang / tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang /

'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang yang dag par ldan pas de'i yang dag pa phyin ci ma log pa'i ye shes/ shes bya'i yul thams cad la mnga' brnyes shing nyon mongs pa ma lus pa la sogs pa rnams spong ba dang / bdud bzhi las rab tu rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang 'di bcom ldan 'das kyis pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu so gnyis kyis yang dag par brgyan pa dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus yang dag par mdzes pa dang / skyes bu chen po'i sku blta bas chog mi shes pa dang / mthong na mi mthun pa med pa ste/ de'i gzugs kyi sku'i 'byor pa mthar thug pa 'gro ba ma lus pa'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di bdag gis rab tu gnas par bgyi'o/ /zhes brjod cing / rab tu gnas par bgyi'o zhes pa'i skabs su thams cad kyis tshig mthun par brjod la/ rten la me tog gi char dbab/ spos kyis bdug rol mo dbul zhing / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te/ samyaksam̐ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa dang / rab tu gnas bya'i lha gang yin gyi sngags dang / rang gi yi dam gyi lha'i sngags bzla ba rnams ni sde tshan re re'i mthar bya'o/ /rjes dran bzhi po gcig dang gsum du brjod pa'i gsal kha mi snang yang / sems bskyed kyi tshig yin pas lan gsum brjod par gsung ngo / /de nas stan la 'dug nas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems cung zad bsgoms la 'di skad brjod de/ ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du dkon mchog gsum gyi rten rab tu gnas par bgyi ba de'i mthus bdag gis sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ngo /

/'khor ba'i gcong rong chen po las bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /phas kyi rgol ba bdud dang log 'dren thams cad pham par bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa thams cad bsal bar bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi nga rgyal gyi ri bo bsnyil bar bgyi'o/ /sems can rnams kyi skye ba'i ljon shing rtsad nas gcad do/ /'chi bdag gi nyi ma phye mar brlag go /ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal bar bgyi'o/ /ma dad pa dang phyir rgol ba dag dang / lta ba phyin ci log pa dag yang dag pa'i lta ba la gzud cing dad par bsgyur ro/ /las kyi chu bo bzlog par bgyi'o/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems par bgyi'o/ /chos kyi sgron ma sbar bar bgyi'o/ /byang chub kyi lam bsten par bgyi'o/ /bzod pa dang des pa la btsud do/ /bsam gtan gyi bde ba la rtser stsal to/ /'dod chags kyi me dpung gzhil bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang gi mtshon rnon po gzhom par bgyi'o/ /bden pa la gzud do/ /phrag dog gi 'tshubs ma zhi bar bgyi'o/ /ser sna'i mdud pa dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa ma mchis pa dang bde ba chen po'i grong khyer du 'jug cing gnas par bgyi'o/ /de bas na bdag la las kyi dngos grub kyi mchog stsal zhing gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis kyang gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor ro/ /drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ rten rnams las thams cad pas bsang / shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang / a las zla ba'am/ khro bo yin na ram̐ las nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du rten ngo shes pa rnams rang rang gi sa bon dang phyag mtshan las so sor bskyed/ mi shes pa rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ de las rgyu rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/

g.yas pa brgyad kyis rdo rje dang / g.yon pa brgyad kyis des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhal rnams rgyu rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba yum dang bcas pa bsgom/ mchod rten dang lha khang ni bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo/ de las rnam snang du bskyed/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rten dang lha khang gi nang du cho ga gsum gyis rigs lnga bskyed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar bsgom/ po ti rnams ni āḥdang padma las 'od dpag med/ rdo rje dang dril bu la sogs pa phyag mtshan rnams ni hūm̐ dang rdo rje las mi bskyod par bskyed/ khang bzang dang / rta babs dang / ljon shing dang / rdo ring dang / chu mig dang / khron pa rnams ni bhrūm̐ dang 'khor lo las rnam par snang mdzad du bsam mo/ /'di dag gi rigs lnga ni gur las 'byung ba ltar zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed pa'am/ dbang chu nas 'byung ba ltar g.yas brgyad kyis 'khor lo zhes sogs sam/ de tsam ma nus na zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa bskyed pas kyang rung ngo / /de rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po bsams la byin gyis brlab bo/ /bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drang zhing dgug pa la gsum/ spyan drang pa dngos/ bgegs bskrad cing mchod pa/ dgug gzhug bya ba'o/ /dang po ni rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod la/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /zhes pa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/

/zhes pa'i bar tshigs su bcad pa gsum dang / chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /zhes pa nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes pa'i bar tshigs su bcad pa bzhi dang / oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ shya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig ces brjod la las thams cad pa'i sngags brjod/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug cing rol mo drag tu bya'o/ /de nas/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /zhes sogs dang / oṃ badzra ga ga na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang / ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis khrus bya zhing / bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /zhes sogs dang / padma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ zhes pas gdan dbul/ lha la sogs pa dri yi rdzas/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad lnga sngags dang bcas pa dang / de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /zhes sogs dang / oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas rol mo rnams dbul lo/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ de ltar mchod pa'i ye shes pa rnams/ oṃ badzra gau rī ā karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa dang nye bar spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes pas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa rnams gzhug oṃ badzra be tā lī bandha baṃ/ zhes pas ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ badzra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing bstim mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs la/

oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/ /'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /che ge mo yi don slad du/ /bdag gi 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa rnams/ /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar dgongs su gsol/ /kun gyis 'di la byin brlabs shing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ sngar ltar dgug gzhug bya'o/ /brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas padma dmar po āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam mo/ /dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga/ yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ khro bo bcu/ lha mo drug dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang / dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes sogs kyis bstod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /zhes sogs kyis dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi steng du dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa/ dbu rgyan/ rdo rje/ dril bu rnams bzhag ste/ dbang chu ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas de dang der gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyis rten la dbang bskur bar bsams la/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rnams slob ma la ji ltar bskur bar ltar bya ste/ de yi tshe bum chu rnams kyis rten la dngos su gtor ba'am/ me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la chu dbang bskur/

dbu rgyan mgo la bcing ba'am/ bris sku sogs yin na 'ching ba'i tshul bya/ rdo rje dang dril bu rnams phyag tu gtad par bsams la mdun du gzhag pa sogs bya/ de nas nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos byang chub kyi sems rten gyi lce la gzhag pa dang / ye shes kyi phyag rgya gtad pas zung 'jug gi ye shes skyes par bsams la gsang ba dang / shes rab ye shes dang / dbang bzhi pa rnams kyang lam dus kyi dbang 'bring gi skabs ltar bskur ro/ /de ltar dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rten ngo shes pa rnams la rang rang gi rigs bdag dang / ngo mi shes pa rnams la mi bskyod pa'am rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /bcu pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod de/ tshigs bcad rnams ni dkyil chog ltar bya ba'am/ zhing khams rgya mtsho ma la sogs pa gang yang rung ba 'don pa bsgyur la bya/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod do/ /bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/ gser drug mnyam las mi chung ba'i thur mas dngul gyi kong bur bzhag pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi blangs pas spyan gyi thad kar byug cing / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsakṣuḥtsakṣuḥs manta tsakṣuḥbi sho dha ni swā hā zhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pa dang ldan zhing sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bsam mo/ /bcu gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rten de la mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa sngags tsam gyis dbul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod la/

sngar gyi rdo rje 'chang zhu ba las byung ba'i rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de bzhin du po ti ni 'od dpag med zhu ba las lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge'i rnam pa glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur par blta/ phyag mtshan rnams ni mi bskyod pa zhu ba las phyag mtshan so so'i dbyibs dang kha dog ji lta ba bzhin du bsam/ khang bzang dang rta babs sogs ni rnam par snang mdzad zhu ba las lha rdzas las grub pa'i khang bzang sogs rang rang gi rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du bsam mo/ /de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir du dpon slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di dag la sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo dbul/ rten 'brel snying po bzla'o/ /'di ni phyag len ltar bris pa yin la/ rab gnas don gsal gyi dpe kun las/ thog mar brtan bzhugs byas nas/ de nas zhal bsgyur ba 'byung ste/ brten bzhugs 'di rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi yin pas 'di ma tshar gyi bar du zhal bsgyur du mi rung ba la dgongs sam snyam mo/ /des na brtan bzhugs kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs pa brtan par byas nas mnga' dbul gyi gong du rang rang gi rnam par bsgyur ba 'di dgongs pa yin pa 'dra'o/ /bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul rgyas par bya ba la bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod rgyas pas mnga' dbul ba ni/

rten gsar pa'i mdun du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham/ bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ dpag tu med par sprul la dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed yod pa kun/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol/ /zhes pa dang / pad skor sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza ma ེgha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad kyi mchod yon dang / sngags kyi arghaṃ rnams kyi gnas su lha rdzas me tog dang / puṣpaṃ/ bdug spos dang / dhū paṃ/ snang gsal dang / dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang / gandhaṃ/ zhal zas dang / nai wi dyāṃ/ sil snyan dang / shabda zhes pa rnams bcug cing / gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra bar byas la/ dharmā ra ṇi ta'i sngags kyis rol mo rgya cher dbul lo/ /mchod yon gyi skabs su chu bzhi char gyi 'don pa bsgyur yang rung la/ yang na 'di tsam gyis kyang rung ngo / /de nas shes shing spro na/ gur nas 'byung ba'i mchod phreng rgyas par bya zhing / de tsam ma nus na/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /de nas bstod pa bya ba'i phyir/ lha so so'i sgos bstod ci shes pas bstod/ de tsam ma shes na/ de nyid lnga pas bstod/ po ti yod na/ dag pas 'dod chags bral bar gyur/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / mchod rten la/ sna tshogs padma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /sna tshogs rin chen khams las grub pa yi/ /sprul pa'i mchod rten sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes/ /chos sku rang bzhin khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / gtsug lag khang yin na/ de'i nang du bskyed pa'i rigs lnga po la/

hūm̐/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /gzugs 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /bdud 'dul chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /mchog sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu/ /kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje bskyod pa'i rlung / /bya grub ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /skyabs sbyin chen po'i phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /zhes pas bstod/ thun mong du/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad/ /yon tan mtha' yas dngos grub thams cad sbyin mdzad pa/ /dri med mi g.yo mnyam nyid dam pa'i mchog chos can/ /yon tan shin tu phra ba'i cha la'ang tshad med de/ /dpe ni nam mkha' dang yang bskrun du yod ma yin/ /dngos grub mtha' yas dpag med dpe dang bral ba rnams/ /sems can khams la dngos grub mchog rnams nges par stsol/ /rtag tu dri ma med pa thugs rje'i shugs las byung / /smon lam grub pa 'gag pa med pa'i chos nyid can/ /'gro ba'i don grub rab tu brtson pa mtha' yas pa/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid rtag tu rnam par snang / /tshad med tshad dang bral ba shin tu rdzogs pa yi/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i go 'phang dam pa brnyes gyur kyang / /khams gsum rnams la dngos grub mchog rnams stsol mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa mi g.yo 'gag par yong mi 'gyur/ /e ma hoḥshin tu bzang po'i chos nyid mchog dang ldan/ /mchog sbyin rnams kyi nang na go 'phang mchog brnyes pa/

/khams gsum kun la rtag tu dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad/ /mgon po dus gsum sgrib pa med par rab mkhyen pas/ /dam tshig mchog gsum dngos grub dam pa bdag la stsol/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yang dag yon tan rgya che ste/ /lan gcig tsam zhig brjod pas kyang / /sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu nye bar mkho bas mnga' dbul ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po rten thams cad la mnga' dbul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor khrus dang na bza' brgyan/ /rnam lnga rin chen bdun dang bcud/ /gdugs sogs dag ni spyi yi 'o/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po dkyil 'khor ni/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i maṇḍal bris te phul bar bsams la/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzhi legs par brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ gnyis pa khrus ni/ dri zhim po'i chus bkru zhing / stong gsum kun tu dri ngad 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum pa na bza' ni/ rten rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can rnams la ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan phul bar bsams la/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang / /dad pas ngur smrig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra wasatra ye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang / sangs rgyas longs sku dang / byang sems khyim pa'i cha lugs kyi rten dang / mchod rten dang / glegs bam rnams la dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' rnams dbul zhing / kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde/ /srab 'jam yangs mdzes lha las byung ba yi/

/na bza'i mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wa sa sye āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi pa rgyan ni/ rin po che'i rgyan mang po dbul zhing / rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /rgyan gzhan dag gis brgyan par mi 'tshal yang / /rin chen rgyan mchog phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku lus thob par shog /oṃ badzra ā laṃ ka ra wa pū kha ni āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lnga pa 'dod yon lnga ni/ gzugs sogs 'dod yon ci 'byor ba dbul zhing / rgyal ba zag med 'byor la mnga' bsgyur yang / /'gro ba'i don du 'dod yon rnam lnga yi/ /mchod pas mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /bsod nams mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ badzra sa mandha bha dra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ drug pa rin chen bdun ni/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs dbul zhing / mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bsam zhing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis/ /'gro bas mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /oṃ badzra sapta ratna pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bdun pa bcud ni/ rin po che'i snod gcig gam sngar sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga rnams blugs pa dbul zhing / rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs/ /bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la/ /lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul/ /'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog /oṃ badzra pañtsa pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ brgyad pa gdugs sogs ni/ gdugs dang / ba dan dang / bla re dang / rol mo la sogs pa dbul zhing / brtse ba'i khor yug snyan pa'i ba dan dang / /ting 'dzin bla re spobs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /mchog rkyen 'os pa'i nyer mkho 'di dag 'bul/ /skye bos rnam dag ye shes thob par shog /oṃ ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes pa rnams thun mong du dbul lo/ /gnyis pa rten so so la mnga' dbul ba la gsum las/ dang po sku gzugs la mnga' dbul ba ni/ spu gri 'dreg spyad so mang dang / /rmang gzer tshems shing spabs bzhar ro/ /zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang po ni/ rten rab byung gi cha lugs can rnams la/ gser gyi spu gris dbu skra dang zhal spu 'dreg pa'i tshul bya zhing / rgyal ba'i dbu skra mthon mthing skyon bral yang / /gzhan don bsgrub phyir khyim pa'i rtags spang phyir/ /dad pas gser gyi 'dreg spyad phul ba yis/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal kun las grol bar shog /oṃ badzra ka tsa mu la āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa ni/ gser gyi 'dreg spyad kyis sen mo 'dreg pa'i tshul bya zhing / zangs mdog ltar mdzad yid 'ong skyon bral yang / /bdag cag dad pas phyag dang zhabs rnams kyis/ /sen mo'i 'dreg spyad phul bas 'gro kun gyis/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang po thob par shog /oṃ badzra na ga tshe da dzi na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum pa ni/ rten longs sku'i cha lugs can rnams dang / byang sems khyim pa'i cha lugs can rnams la gser gyi so mang gis dbu skra bshad pa'i tshul bya zhing / dbu skra rin chen lcang lo mi 'khrug cing / /mdzes shing blta bas mi ngoms skyon bral yang / /bdag blo sbyang phyir rkyen dang 'tshams pa 'di/ /phul bas 'gro kun dug gsum bral bar shog /oṃ badzra bā la sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi pa ni/ gser gyi rmang gzer dbul zhing / dri 'dzin rnam dag tshul khrims las 'khrungs pa/ /dge ba bsgrub phyir skyon las nges grol yang / /mos pas 'dzin spyad dam pa phul ba yis/ /'gro bas bla med byang chub thob par shog /oṃ badzra ro ma dha ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lnga pa ni/ gser dngul las byas pa'i tshems shing dbul zhing / dkar la thags bzangs bzhi bcu tshang ba'i tshems/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos la mnga' bsgyur yang /

/bdag cag dad pas tshems shing 'bul lags kyi/ /'gro bas sangs rgyas gsung dbyangs thob par shog /oṃ badzra danta sho dha ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ drug pa ni/ gser gyi spabs bzhar dbul zhing / snyan bsring mi mnga' kun tu gsal bar ldan/ /thub pa'i sgra 'dzin ngo bos dag na yang / /dag byed 'di ni bdag gis 'bul lags kyi/ /skye bos rtag tu dam chos thos par shog /oṃ badzra karṇa sho ngha ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo/ /de'ang gsang 'dus la sogs pa'i zhal sbyor gyis sku la ni spu gri dang 'dreg spyad mi dbul zhing / tshe dpag med la sogs pa longs sku'i rnam pa can la ni spu gri ma gtogs pa gzhan lnga ka dbul zhing / thub dbang la sogs pa sprul sku rnams la so mang mi dbul bar gzhan lnga ka dbul lo/ /gnyis pa mchod rten la mnga' dbul ba ni/ srog shing 'khor lo cod paṇa 'phan/ /rgyal mtshan gdugs dang phreng ba gdan/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po srog shing dbul zhing / oṃ badzra ā yuḥṣe swā hā/ sems can thams cad shes pa bcu dang ldan par gyur cig bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa'i dam chos yun ring du mi nub cing gnas par gyur cig sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas kun tu bzang po'i smon lam la 'jug par gyur cig gnyis pa 'khor lo dbul zhing / oṃ pra mardā na ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ma 'dres pa'i dran pa nye bar gzhag pa gsum thob par gyur cig rnam par thar pa brgyad thob par gyur cig ye shes lnga thob par gyur cig gsum pa dar gyi cod paṇa dbul zhing / oṃ pa taṃ kā laṃ pa ya swā hā/ sems can thams cad dus thams cad du dar gyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub la sogs pa mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur gyi rnam pa mang pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang / de dag gi mchod rten dang / sku gzugs dang / gsung rab la sogs pa dag la mchod pa byed par gyur cig

bzhi pa 'phan dbul zhing / oṃ pa taṃ ke swā hā/ sems can thams cad chos kyi grags pa'i snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur cig lnga pa chu srin gyis rgyal mtshan dbul zhing / oṃ ku bi ra dhwa dza swā hā/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba mi 'dzin mi gtong bas bdud bzhi las rgyal zhing chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig drug pa gdugs dbul zhing / oṃ bhra ma na ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i skyabs dang ldan zhing chos kyi rgyal po chen por gyur cig bdun pa me tog gi phreng ba dbul zhing / oṃ ratna mā la trām̐ zhes bya ba dang / na maḥsatrai ya dhā/ a nu ga ta pra tiṣṭha ta puṣpe ke tu rā dza/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sems can thams cad mtshan dang dpe byad dang ldan te/ sku blta bas chog mi shes pa thob par gyur cig brgyad pa rin po che la sogs pa'i gdan dbul bar bsam zhing / oṃ puṇya dha ri dza ye swā hā/ sems can thams cad gdan gyi khyad par stobs bcu dang ldan pa glang po che'i gdan dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang ldan pa seng ge'i gdan dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang ldan pa rta'i gdan dang / dbang bcu dang ldan pa rma bya'i gdan dang / thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang ldan pa nam mkha' lding gi gdan dang / 'gro ba'i re 'dod yid bzhin du skong ba nor bu rin po che'i gdan dang / chags pa'i skyon spangs pa padma'i gdan dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba nyi zla'i gdan thob par gyur cig ces brjod cing dbul lo/ /gsum pa glegs bam la mnga' dbul ba ni/ bzhugs khri dang ni na bza' dang / /glegs shing dang ni glegs thag go /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po rin po che'i khri dbul zhing / rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri/ /yi 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di/ /spros bral gsung rab mchog la phul ba yis/

/'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badzra ā sa na ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gnyis pa na bza' dbul zhing / sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu bzhin rab bkra yang / /gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i/ /gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul/ /bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wasatra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gsum pa glegs shing dbul zhing / zung 'jug dam chos 'dzin pa kun bral la/ /thabs dang shes rab rjes su 'brel gyur pa'i/ /nyi zla lta bu'i rten 'brel dgab bya ba/ /phul bas skye bos zung 'jug rtogs par shog /oṃ badzra pra dzñā u pa ya a dā ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzhi pa glegs thag dbul zhing / spros pa du ma rab tu rgyas gyur kyang / /ye shes chen por ro gcig gyur pa ltar/ /glegs bam gcig gyur yo byad phul ba yis/ /'gro bas ye shes chen po rtogs par shog /oṃ badzra spho ta ka bhandha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dbul lo/ /gsum pa sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul ba ni/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho gas rab tu gnas bya'i lha dang / glegs bam yin na 'od dpag med dang / lha khang yin na rnam snang thab tu spyan drangs la/ mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i 'brus gtsor byas pa'i bsreg blugs brgya rtsa brgyad dbul/ bdag dang yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba'i phyir du dūrba dang 'bras kyi sbyin sreg ci grub bya/ de'i rjes su thab khung gi me la mañdzi'i steng du tshon dkar po'am ser pos byugs pa'i snod bzhag la/ de'i nang du 'bras dang / sbrang rtsi dang / ka ra bsres pa'i 'o ma blugs la gtso bo'i sngags zlos bzhin du 'o thug bsgrubs la 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad dang / sngags kyis rten la dbul lo/ /gal te 'o thug ma grub na snod bzang por lha bshos chen po rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa zhig gi mthar/ bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / btung ba sna tshogs bshams la/

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas 'dod rgu'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas rten la phul bar bsam zhing / zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i yid 'phrog pa/ /legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la/ /dad pas phul bas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ dī bya a ne sa mā dhīndā yā na pṛ ṇa ne swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /bzhi pa sngags kyi mnga' dbul ba ni/ rten la gzungs thag btags par kun gyis bzung la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhū khaṃ badzrī bha wa ḍi ḍa tiṣṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad dam nyer gcig bzlas la/ thams cad kyis lag tu me tog thogs nas/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad 'don cing / rten la me tog gi char phab pas bkra shis par bsams la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o/ /gsum pa la mjug gi cho ga ni/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo/ /yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod/ /rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo/ /slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya/ /slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod/ /rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no/ /zhes pa ltar bcu gcig las/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ gtor ma rnams bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/ dang po lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi cho gas 'das pa dang / gnyis pa nag po chen po lcam dral dang / gsum pa gdong bzhi pa dang / bzhi pa las mgon dang / lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul lo/ /gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam mchod rten gang la gtad par 'dod pa'i chos skyong la gtor ma rgya chen po phul la/ khyed kyis rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di la bsrung ba dang / skyong bar gyis shig ces brjod/ de nus pa bskyed pa'i phyir rdo rje'i go cha'i phyag rgya dang /

oṃ badzra rakṣa haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i go bskon pas nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par bsams la/ de bdag gis bka' las mi 'da' ba'i phyir rdo rje thogs nas/ rdo rje 'di ni rdo rje che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ /gal te dam las 'das gyur na/ /zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /oṃ ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ yang de'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag par bsams la/ bdag dang yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la bsrung ba dang / bsams pa thams cad 'grub pa dang / rten 'di la mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rgyun mi chad par gyis shig ces dam la gzhag go/ //gsum pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ mdun du stan ser po'i steng du sbyin bdag thal mo sbyar nas 'dug tu bcug la/ khyod kyis nga la gang gsol ba'i/ /sku gzugs dag ni khyad par du/ /ji ltar gsungs pa ji bzhin du/ /de dag don ni ngas byas te/ /de rnams don ni grub zin gyi/ /ci bde bar ni mchod par byos/ /zhes dang / khyod kyis nga la gsol ba btab pa'i rab tu gnas pa de legs par tshar bar byas kyi/ rten 'di la zhag bdun du mchod pa rgya chen po gyis shig de nas kyang ci 'byor ba'i mchod pas rgyun mi chad par mchod pa gyis shig ces bsgo'o/ /bzhi pa shis pa brjod pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang sngags kyis yon bdag bsang la/ de skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar bsams te/ me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis khro bo spyan drangs zhing / bstod pa dang bden pa brdar nas/ sbyin bdag 'khor bcas bkra shis par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig ces brjod la/ las thams cad pa bzlos shing rol mo drag tu byas la bgegs bsal lo/ /de nas bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad mdun du 'dus byas la bsang sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las mam̐ las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad sbyin bdag la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang /

bsod nams dang / dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la dpon slob thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yi/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag thogs med chos la longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlab pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i rten 'di dang / sbyin bdag gis thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod do/ /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dra bar sbyar la/ gi wang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zung rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang sdug bsngal dag gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa srung gis gi wang phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar/ dūrbas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe ni 'phel gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la rtsa 'tshong bkra shis kyis rtsa dūrba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don 'di 'grub par shog

/sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha tshangs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshigs la dbang thob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du 'dus nas kyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par rab byed cing / /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes yungs kar phyag tu phul ba na zhes sogs sbyar ba'i bkra shis brjod cing / bkra shis kyi rdzas rnams rten la dbul zhing / yon bdag rnams kyang reg tu gzhug go/ //lnga pa rten la mchod pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa'i lha'i mdun du mchod pa gsar pa ci 'byor pa bshams la/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i tshigs su bcad pas mchod cing / bstod pa dang / phyag dang / bskor ba ci nus su bya'o// //drug pa bsod nams bsngo ba ni/ slob dpon dpon slob kyis yan lag bdun pa rgyas bsdus gang rung sngon du 'gro bas bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa bya'o// //bdun pa slob dpon mchod pa ni/ sbyin bdag gis slob dpon dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur dang yon dbul bar bya'o// //brgyad pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ rab gnas rgyas par bya ba'i don du gnas khang de nyid dam gzhan du'ang rung ste slob dpon dang /

dge 'dun dang / bzo bo dang / grogs byed pa dang / zhal ta ba rnams la dga' ston gyi bsnyen bkur rgyas par bya zhing / sngar gyi tsā ru'i bza' ba lha la phul ba'i lhag ma rnams tshogs pa thams cad la drang zhing / bde gshegs lhag ma 'di dag ni/ /zo zhig sdig pa byang bar 'gyur/ /zhes brjod do// //dgu pa slar yang shis par bya ba ni/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci shes pas der tshogs pa rnams bkra shis par bya zhing / rten mchod pa'i bsam pas glu dang / gar dang / rol mo la sogs pa ci nus par bya'o// //bcu pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ slob dpon dpon slob rnams kyis rab gnas kyi mnga' dbul dang / khrus stegs la sogs pa rnams bsdu zhing / las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la/ rnyed pa rnams kyang bgos te/ gos zung la sogs pa rnams ni 'phan dang rgyal mtshan du byas te mchod rten nam gtsug lag khang du dbul/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad dman ma rnams phongs pa dang mgon med pa rnams la sbyin zhing / khyi dang / bya rog sogs la ni lhag par dkor du 'gyur bas mi sbyin par bshad do// //bcu gcig pa sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ cho ga'i lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir mtshan mo zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya zhing ma grub na yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla'o/ /yon bdag gis kyang zhag bdun du rten la mchod pa bar ma chad du dbul zhing / de nas kyang ci nus pa'i mchod pa bya ste cho ga 'bring gi rim pa'o/ /bsdus pa dang / rgyas pa ni rab gnas don gsal ltar shes par bya'o// //dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal gnas cho ga 'di/ /'dun ldan slob mas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun mchog dag gis/ /legs par bkral shing bla ma'i phyag len ltar/ /ji lta'i gnas lugs 'byed pa'i bzhin ras gsal/ /ji bzhin mthong ba brgyud pa'i mig ldan zhing / /ji snyed gzhung bzang thos pa'i rna ba can/ /ji tsam smra la 'jigs med seng ges sbyar/

/dge tshogs rin chen gang zhig thob pa des/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i dbul ba kun sel zhing / /rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams/ /'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dpal du 'gyur bar shog/ //dpal kyai rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyis rten la rab tu gnas par bya ba'i cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer gyi slob ma dge 'dun dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po yab sras kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges thub bstan rnam par rgyal ba'i dgon par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhon nu bzang pos bgyis so// //'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba de ni gang thob pa/ /des ni skye bo thams cad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 go bo rab 'byams pa/ rab gnas cho ga dge legs rgya mtsho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
